scope_note: Conceptual synthesis of protected assertions and compatible pathways. Citations support mechanisms and control assumptions, not a claim that every combination was tested in financial deployment. The claims are not independent scores or a security guarantee.

claims.label: Media authenticity
claims.description: What evidence concerns the presentation or synthesis/alteration of media, and what can survive replay or processing?
claims.title: Media authenticity

claims.label: Identity consistency
claims.description: Does the claimant correspond to the claimed identity, and was the enrolled or documentary reference already contaminated?
claims.title: Identity consistency

claims.label: Capture and session provenance
claims.description: Do capture, liveness, matching and challenge decisions refer to the same trusted, fresh event rather than substituted inputs?
claims.title: Capture and session provenance

claims.label: Valid business authorization
claims.description: Is the identity event bound to the intended account, privileges and requested action? Correct facial matching alone does not establish consent.
claims.title: Valid business authorization

scenarios.label: Printed portraits and ordinary replay
scenarios.description: An artifact reaches the capture device. Reproduction and recapture cues depend on instrument and sensor.
scenarios.reference_risk: Probe presentation changes; the enrolled reference need not be altered.
scenarios.title: Printed portraits and ordinary replay

scenarios.label: Three-dimensional mask presentation
scenarios.description: A mask challenges planar assumptions and material/geometry evidence under the actual sensing configuration.
scenarios.reference_risk: Impersonation may use an otherwise genuine victim reference.
scenarios.title: Three-dimensional mask presentation

scenarios.label: Generated or manipulated media replay
scenarios.description: Swapped, reenacted or generated content is displayed to a camera; synthesis and recapture are distinct observations.
scenarios.reference_risk: A claimed identity may be reproduced without contaminating its reference.
scenarios.title: Generated or manipulated media replay

scenarios.label: Post-capture media injection
scenarios.description: A processing path supplies recorded or synthetic media without physical traces expected from presentation attacks.
scenarios.reference_risk: Matching can accept an input whose capture provenance is invalid.
scenarios.title: Post-capture media injection

scenarios.label: Morph-contaminated enrollment
scenarios.description: A multi-contributor portrait enters a reference before issuance. An authentic signature alone does not establish pre-signing identity correctness.
scenarios.reference_risk: A persistent reference can match multiple contributors; later genuine probes do not repair enrollment.
scenarios.title: Morph-contaminated enrollment

scenarios.label: Cross-component sample substitution
scenarios.description: Liveness and matching accept different samples or events. Binding is needed even when both components report success.
scenarios.production: genuine or manipulated samples combined across events
scenarios.reference_risk: Approved capture can be associated with a different matching probe or account reference.
scenarios.title: Cross-component sample substitution
